292:0.en: 「This is $$マシンキャリバー$$ K6821.\nCarrying out the mission.」

292:428.en: 「I'll down it before it leaves range.」

292:1105.en: 「Tactical disadvantage confirmed.\nSending SOS, continuing the mission.」

292:1221.en: 「Combat continuation is impossible.\nI'll withdraw before full shutdown.」

292:1310.en: 「I expect Ensign $$レド$$ to get results.」

292:1586.en: 「$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ approach confirmed.\nThreat level assessed: high.」

292:1747.en: 「The $$人類銀河同盟$$\nrecognizes $$サイデリアル$$ as hostile.」

292:1806.en: 「Data matched... Enemy is $$サイデリアル$$.」

292:2109.en: 「Enemy data updated.\nOptimizing evasion program as well.」

292:2473.en: 「Updating enemy threat assessment.\nBe on guard from here on.」

292:2524.en: 「Equipment and power both normal.\nCombat can continue.」

292:2768.en: 「This unit is at a disadvantage.\nRecommend aiming at the cockpit.」

292:2821.en: 「Unit damage rising.\nThis unit is badly disadvantaged.」

292:3057.en: 「Non-combatants are not permitted in the cockpit. Vacate this unit immediately.」

292:3126.en: 「I am a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System.」

292:3163.en: 「My reason for existing is fulfilled when you achieve greater results.」

292:3224.en: 「Survive. Explore. This unit expects maximum results from that life.」

292:3315.en: 「$$レド$$! We're here! We fight with you!」

292:3366.en: 「Being apart from you, I finally understood. No matter how hard it gets, I want to be by your side! So!」

292:3455.en: 「So come back! To what you protected!」

292:4214.en: 「$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...! I'll annihilate you...!」

292:4249.en: 「The $$人類銀河同盟$$\nwill not allow the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ to live!」

292:4335.en: 「If I drop the leader unit,\nthey should settle down...!」

292:4470.en: 「I won't let you touch the fleet...!」

292:4501.en: 「Are $$サイデリアル$$ on this planet too...!」

292:4542.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$: the Alliance's enemy...!」

292:4583.en: 「Have they expanded all the way\nout to this frontier...!」

292:4669.en: 「Focus the attack on a single unit!」

292:5088.en: 「I'll deal as much damage as I can!」

292:5207.en: 「As if an attack like that would hit.」

292:5257.en: 「Without numbers on their side,\neven $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...!」

292:5308.en: 「Don't think it'll be easy, $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$!」

292:5417.en: 「As a fellow commander, see the odds\nand withdraw your troops.」

292:5569.en: 「This isn't going to be a real fight.」

292:5635.en: 「Taking a few hits would be risky.」

292:5718.en: 「Damn it! I took that one head-on...!」

292:5757.en: 「I suppose I can't\nescape unscathed, after all...!」

292:5837.en: 「I can't go down to the likes of you!」

292:5876.en: 「Fighting us evenly or better\nin a machine like that...!」

292:6090.en: 「Will I die... in a place like this?!」

292:6181.en: 「It ends... in a place like this...?!」

292:6239.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, how far is the enemy unit?」

292:6382.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, shift to combat readiness!」

292:6421.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, opening a shelling duel!」

292:6633.en: 「Then I'll have to hurt you a little.」

292:6703.en: 「Take care to inflict as few\nhuman casualties as possible!」

292:6915.en: 「Attacking the enemy squad\nwith the Deflector Beam!」

292:7054.en: 「In front of the allies, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

292:7114.en: 「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, where is the enemy unit?!」

292:7218.en: 「Brace for the next attack, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

292:7280.en: 「These $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are nothing special.」

292:7441.en: 「That said, I won't keep taking hits.」

292:7647.en: 「No!\nI can't leave $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ like this!」

292:7702.en: 「Can't a single unit\nstand up to the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...!」

292:7751.en: 「Why can that machine do this much?!」

292:7792.en: 「Denied! I don't want anyone to die!」

292:7911.en: 「Reconsider tactics!\nOffer every plan you can think of!」

292:7960.en: 「Shifting to retreat mode!\nI'll watch for an opening to leave!」

292:8129.en: 「What are you doing, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

292:8284.en: 「What's with the penny-pinching? Be a man and sink it all into weapon mods!」

292:8347.en: 「Ignore that stiff-headed Tin Can's way of doing things!」

292:8455.en: 「Well, $$レド$$? How far have you gotten in Super Robot Wars?」

292:8516.en: 「Ha ha ha! You can handle a Tin Can, but your game skills are so-so, huh!」

292:8593.en: 「Easy. Make the great $$ピニオン$$ an ace pilot and it's a breeze!」

292:8786.en: 「Man, it's been a while since release, but I finally got my hands on it!」

292:8896.en: 「Later, all! I'm off to try it now!」
